subject: Collaborative Close Playbook — initial MAP + timeline
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Alex Carter <alex.carter@stellarhealth.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Collaborative Close Playbook — initial MAP + timeline

Alex —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. To make the evaluation and procurement window as frictionless as possible, I attached a lightweight Collaborative Close Playbook (a MAP-style template) and a 30-day evaluation checklist that we use for pilots like yours.

High-level suggested timeline (provisional):
- Week 0: Kickoff + stakeholder alignment (identify technical + procurement owners)
- Week 1: Integration + baseline throughput tests (small dataset)
- Week 2: Latency/cost trade-offs, caching/batching validation
- Week 3: Acceptance testing against success criteria (safety, latency, recall)
- Week 4: Executive review & procurement handoff

Quick asks: can you share the names/emails of your security and procurement reps? Also, would Thursday 6/6 at 10am PT work for a 30m sync to walk the doc and lock owners?

I've added a few placeholder acceptance criteria in the template — recommend we align those in the sync.

Attachments: collab_playbook_template_v1.gdoc (GDoc stub), 30day-eval-checklist.xlsx

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
D: 415-555-0123 | dylan.brooks@redwood.com

--
Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference platform for predictable, low-latency LLM serving

Dylan —

Thanks for the template, this is helpful. A few quick notes from our side:

- Procurement will need a statement of data handling + retention for the pilot (our legal lead is cc'd on future threads).
- Can we tighten the acceptance criteria around P95 latency to < 450ms for the 8k-context flows? That's a hard blocker for our UX team.
- Security wants to run a short design review (30–45m) with your infra/security rep during Week 1.

I've attached the signed NDA here so procurement can move in parallel: NDA_signed.pdf

Thursday 6/6 10am PT works for Alex + our PM (I've penciled it in). For the sync, we'll invite our Security lead (Maya Singh) and Procurement (procure@stellarhealth.ai).

Appreciate the fast turnaround — looking forward to aligning the MAP.

Best,
